canonical_project: Hanton City Business Park / Revity data-center concept
aliases: Hanton City Business Park / Revity data-center concept
status_as_of_cutoff: Local process / appeal pending; construction was not verified. The project appears in Smithfield planning materials as PLN-26-10, Smithfield Corporate Complex, a major land development master-plan application received 2026-05-05. Local reporting tied to the Smithfield Zoning Board of Review / Board of Appeals says the administrative officer issued a second certificate of incompleteness on 2026-06-11, and Case 26-011 was continued on 2026-08-05 to a 2026-09-02 hearing. No site-plan approval, building permit, construction, energization, public MW value, or fixed data-center lot was verified.

status_history.status: Proposed and locally blocked by data-center restriction activity; construction was not verified. The official April work-session record describes an unsettled six-lot business-park concept, with approximately 559,000 square feet discussed and no fixed data-center lot; later town records concern restriction/policy action, not project approval.
status_history.reason_retired: 2026-08-11 refresh found newer local-process evidence: planning materials list PLN-26-10 as received, and Board of Appeals coverage records a second incompleteness certificate and continued appeal.
